scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A seated king in an ivory robe, russet mantle, and gold circlet receives two men offering folded purple cloth and a clay jar. Woven baskets and rolled textiles fill the foreground; a laden donkey stands beyond the sunlit stone courtyard among olive trees and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined tribute audience illustrates the kingdoms bringing tribute and serving Solomon. The envoys, gifts, clothing, courtyard, and arriving donkey are illustrative choices; the verse does not specify them. The distant road suggests the reach of his rule without mapping its borders. The figures and architecture are imaginative conventions, not historical likenesses or archaeological certainty.
